uncovered_crash_windows: SIGKILL/kernel/power loss and fsync durability on the actual Kaggle filesystem.
Backend accepts or executes a request but the client dies before persisting the response; the outcome stays unknown and the intent blocks replay.
Process loss after F response persistence and before HF; the runner has no resume/reconcile flow and HF may remain unsent.
Torn JSONL writes, filesystem-full failures, and recovery of a partial journal were not fault-injected.
Cross-host/network-filesystem flock semantics were not tested.
Real server receipt/duplicate suppression, Kaggle deployment state, and frozen model/backend artifact hashes were not verified.
